["Omnibus order: section 1 revokes dozens of earlier orders and sections 3 to 31 amend or revoke provisions of other orders (62 inventory units). Deciding each unit needs, for every revoked or amended parent, a held source that dates its performance and shows what survives; the packet holds no such sources beyond section 26, which Executive Order 13242 (2001-12-18) revoked, and its chain events (Executive Orders 12620 to 13816) are amendments of parent orders, not endings of this order. Missing: held current text or status of each amended parent (for example Executive Orders 10289, 10530, 10624, 10840, 11030, 11077, 11390, 11845, 12163 as of 2026-10-14) and the effective dates of sections 1 to 31."]
